digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard at sync and push sites
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch must refuse union at both sync._union_merge and push.py non-FF retry sites instead of silently re-unioning stripped history

The epoch field is stored in .store-compat.json as an opaque JSON string and compared for byte equality only; record-absent, epoch-absent, equal-epoch, mismatched-epoch, corrupt, and unreadable-ref cases must be distinguished and handled according to the specified state matrix

On epoch mismatch, sync._union_merge returns without merging to leave the clone un-converged, while push.py aborts the retry loop immediately and returns from push_tickets_branch to prevent merge and re-push attempts
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED and local/remote tips must remain byte-for-byte unchanged with zero merge invocations
A merely-behind clone with matching epochs must still converge via fast-forward, and a strictly-ahead clone must still return early—the guard placement does not wedge convergence
The guard reads the remote .store-compat.json via git show rather than the local worktree, distinguishing ref-unreadable from file-absent in error messages
